frequency_question: How often has the countercyclical capital buffer been activated above 0% across comparable jurisdictions and timeframes?
membership_rule: Includes G20 central banks with a formal macroprudential framework capable of adjusting the CCyB during periods without acute systemic crises. Excludes jurisdictions lacking independent monetary or macroprudential authority.
window: A rolling 3-year observation window corresponding to the duration specified in the question.

cases.name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand activation

provenance_note: claims 24 cases from only 6 named (4.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 14 hits across 24 observed jurisdictional cycles; broad international precedent exists, though US implementation has historically remained at zero.
known_gaps: US regulatory inertia differs structurally from peer European and Pacific jurisdictions which utilized the tool earlier.
skeleton: Defined peer central bank regulatory jurisdictions with active countercyclical capital buffer frameworks times evaluation cycles
multiplier: 8 major jurisdictions observed across 3 distinct macroeconomic expansion cycles
validity_reason: Macroprudential frameworks and international Basel III standards remain stable over multi-year horizons.
